h: Hounslow High Street, under the flight path
p: Hounslow's High Street is a busy, multicultural shopping strip, with Hounslow Central and Hounslow East stations on the Piccadilly line close by and a steady stream of planes overhead heading in and out of Heathrow, just a few miles west. You'll find no shortage of places to eat along here, with South Asian cafés, sweet shops and takeaways a big part of the street's character.

Palace is 18+ only, so it's one for grown-ups. If you fancy some green space after a session, Hounslow Heath is a big local nature reserve on the edge of town, and the Piccadilly line gets you into central London without any fuss.
